scientific_integrity: Finite complete enumeration of the optimal discrete Morse matchings of the five-vertex simplex. Two independently written exact enumeration and cycle-detection programs agree; no claim of external or independent expert certification.
scientific_limitations: Specific finite complex only; no statement for larger simplices.
Automorphism-orbit and stabilizer counts refine, but do not replace, the already published labelled total.
title: Symmetry classes of optimal discrete Morse matchings on the four-simplex
